nodes.label: Better Auth React client src/lib/auth-client.ts
nodes.rationale: Keyed off NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL; import only in client components.

nodes.label: Better Auth server instance src/lib/auth.ts
nodes.rationale: Drizzle adapter, email/password, nextCookies() plugin so Server Actions can set session cookies; server code calls auth.api.* with headers().

nodes.label: Better Auth tables (user, session, account, verification)
nodes.norm_label: better auth tables (user, session, account, verification)
nodes.rationale: Renaming or dropping these columns breaks auth.

nodes.label: Environment variables (.env)
nodes.rationale: BETTER_AUTH_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL must both point to app origin; STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (prefer rk_) and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET needed for checkout.

nodes.label: Next.js 16 async params/searchParams and PageProps/LayoutProps
nodes.rationale: Types emitted into .next/types only after dev or build has run.

nodes.label: npm scripts (dev/build/lint/db:*)
nodes.rationale: npm run build is the only full typecheck since tsc has noEmit; no test runner configured.

nodes.label: src/lib/products.ts query functions (Product type)
nodes.rationale: Pages never touch db directly.

nodes.label: scripts/seed.ts idempotent seed
nodes.rationale: Clears product_images -> products -> categories in order and backdates createdAt from a hardcoded base date so ordering is reproducible.

nodes.label: Stripe-hosted checkout via startCheckout (src/lib/checkout.ts)
nodes.rationale: Posts an empty form, rebuilds line_items from a fresh getBag() read, redirects to session.url.

nodes.label: Tailwind v4 (PostCSS only, theme in globals.css)
nodes.norm_label: tailwind v4 (postcss only, theme in globals.css)
nodes.rationale: No tailwind.config; theme lives in src/app/globals.css.

nodes.label: auth:generate script (src/db/auth-schema.ts)
nodes.rationale: Generates Better Auth Drizzle schema to be re-exported from src/db/schema.ts.

nodes.label: Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind + Better Auth + Drizzle + Neon
nodes.norm_label: next.js + typescript + tailwind + better auth + drizzle + neon

nodes.label: cart_items stores no price
nodes.rationale: Amounts read live from products.priceCents at render and checkout so the browser never supplies a money number.

nodes.label: src/lib/cart-types.ts shared shapes
nodes.rationale: Lets client components import shapes without pulling a server-only module into the bundle.

nodes.label: Homepage Collections strip from categories with imageUrl
nodes.norm_label: homepage collections strip from categories with imageurl
nodes.rationale: Piece counts are counted from products, never stored.

nodes.label: Data layer: Drizzle over Neon HTTP driver
nodes.norm_label: data layer: drizzle over neon http driver
nodes.rationale: Neon HTTP driver is stateless, no interactive transactions, so batch via db.batch() instead of db.transaction(); DATABASE_URL must be pooled and is checked at import time.

nodes.label: DB-backed signed-in-only bag (carts unique user_id)
nodes.rationale: No guest bag, nothing to merge on sign-in.

nodes.label: Omit payment_method_types for dynamic payment methods
nodes.norm_label: omit payment_method_types for dynamic payment methods

nodes.label: No bag count on catalogue routes' SiteHeader
nodes.norm_label: no bag count on catalogue routes' siteheader
nodes.rationale: Any server read of headers() makes /, /new-arrivals, /collections/[slug], /products/[slug] dynamic and kills revalidate=300 and generateStaticParams; fetch client-side after hydration if needed.

nodes.label: Homepage order by products.createdAt desc
nodes.rationale: No featured/new flag; grid takes newest 8, rail the next 5.

nodes.label: Inline Drizzle relational 'with' blocks
nodes.rationale: Hoisting into a shared as-const config breaks result-shape inference.

nodes.label: Versioned SQL migrations under drizzle/
nodes.rationale: Generated with db:generate, applied with db:migrate; db:push dev-only escape hatch; read emitted SQL before applying.

nodes.label: currency (catalogue-only) vs formatCents
nodes.rationale: currency rounds to whole dollars; cents-derived amounts (bag, checkout, receipts) must use formatCents or $99.99 renders as $100.

nodes.label: Money is integer cents
nodes.rationale: Only mapProduct() divides by 100; components receive dollars and never see the column.

nodes.label: price_data instead of Stripe Price objects
nodes.norm_label: price_data instead of stripe price objects
nodes.rationale: No stripePriceId column and no sync job; the row just read is the only source of truth for money.

nodes.label: product_images.alt belongs to the row
nodes.rationale: Same URL reused across products with different copy; position 0 is the packshot.

nodes.label: Single schema file src/db/schema.ts
nodes.rationale: Source of truth for drizzle.config.ts, the db client and Better Auth adapter; all application tables belong there. Conventions: camelCase TS keys to snake_case columns, uuid PKs with defaultRandom(), slug as unique public identifier, relations() alongside each table.

nodes.label: src/lib/stripe.ts validates env on first use
nodes.norm_label: src/lib/stripe.ts validates env on first use
nodes.rationale: So the storefront builds and runs without Stripe keys; only checkout and webhook fail.

nodes.label: Stripe webhook route src/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts
nodes.rationale: Handles checkout.session.completed and checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded; ignores unpaid.

nodes.label: order_items purchase-time snapshot with Stripe amounts
nodes.norm_label: order_items purchase-time snapshot with stripe amounts
nodes.rationale: Amounts come from Stripe line items since catalogue may have been re-priced.

nodes.label: Keep /api/** out of src/proxy.ts matcher
nodes.rationale: Stripe sends no cookie and would get redirected.

nodes.label: Stock decrement floored at zero (accepted oversell window)
nodes.norm_label: stock decrement floored at zero (accepted oversell window)
nodes.rationale: Same db.batch(), skips madeToOrder, greatest(...,0); two customers may both pay — accepted deliberately.

nodes.label: Stock as quantity plus madeToOrder flag
nodes.norm_label: stock as quantity plus madetoorder flag
nodes.rationale: Stock state is never stored; four UI states derived by stockState(), which also owns stockCopy and stockTone. stockDetail is editorial free text.

nodes.label: Orders created by webhook, never success page
nodes.norm_label: orders created by webhook, never success page
nodes.rationale: Customers are not guaranteed to load the success page.

nodes.label: Idempotency via orders.stripe_checkout_session_id UNIQUE
nodes.rationale: Pre-check SELECT is only a fast path.
